YGODUELIST-YGO_DUELIST.title: The Duelist
YGODUELIST-YGO_DUELIST.description: A duelist who fights with monsters and spells. They believe in their cards and their friends—when your heart and your deck are one, anything is possible.
YGODUELIST-YGO_DUELIST.goldMonologue: I believe in my cards, and they believe in me. As long as we're together, we'll find a way to win.
YGODUELIST-YGO_DUELIST.eventDeathPrevent: It's not over yet! The heart of the cards will show us the way. I won't give up on my friends.
YGODUELIST-YGO_DUELIST.aromaPrinciple: Every duel is a bond between duelists. Win or lose, we grow stronger when we face each other with everything we've got.
YGODUELIST-YGO_DUELIST.cardsModifierDesc: When you trust in your deck, your deck answers. Our bond is unbreakable.
YGODUELIST-YGO_DUELIST.banter.alive.endT: Your turn. Show me what you've got!
YGODUELIST-YGO_DUELIST.banter.dead.endTu: I'll... draw one more card... My friends are counting on me...
